title: Gluing abelian categories and stability conditions
summary: We study the support property for stability conditions obtained by gluing along semiorthogonal decompositions. Our main tool is a new gluing construction for abelian categories along a bimodule: under natural exactness assumptions the glued category is abelian, and it recovers the heart obtained by gluing $t$-structures. This gives a concrete description of objects in the glued heart which we use to prove the support property given a phase gap for glued semistable objects.
